10 REM *** PC-1600 Z80 I2C SPEED LAB V1.1 (INSTALLER+SPEED+BMP280 TEST) ***
20 REM FIRST: NEW "S0:",&800. BMP280 AT &77. SDA DIODE ON PIN 31 (Z80)
30 CLEAR : WAIT 0 : D = &77 : IC = &C400 : IA = &C5FC : TX = &C700 : RX = &C600
40 IF PEEK (&C500) <> 243 THEN GOSUB 3500
45 PRINT "Installing V0..."
46 RESTORE 4000
47 GOSUB 2000
48 PRINT "Clearing TX..."
49 FOR I = 0 TO 254 : POKE TX + I, 0 : NEXT I
50 WAIT 64 : PRINT "CALL OVERHEAD, PORTS" : WAIT 0
52 A = 50528 : GOSUB 1800 : OV = H / N
54 WAIT 128 : PRINT "BASIC CALL "; INT (OV * 10000 + .5) / 10; " ms"
55 FOR J = 0 TO 2 : A = 50432 + J * 32 : GOSUB 1800
60 U = (H / N - OV) * 1000000 / 2560 : T$ = MID$ ("OUT IN  NOP ", J * 4 + 1, 4)
65 PRINT T$; INT (U * 100 + .5) / 100; " us" : NEXT J
100 R0 = 0 : FOR V = 0 TO 3
110 IF V = 1 THEN RESTORE 5000
112 IF V = 1 THEN GOSUB 2000
115 IF V = 2 THEN RESTORE 6000
117 IF V = 2 THEN GOSUB 2000
118 IF V = 3 THEN RESTORE 7000
119 IF V = 3 THEN GOSUB 2000
120 WAIT 64 : PRINT "TRY V"; V : WAIT 128
130 GOSUB 1500
140 IF F <> 0 AND V = 0 THEN PRINT "V0 FAIL "; F; " CHECK WIRING" : END
145 IF F <> 0 THEN PRINT "V"; V; " FAIL "; F : GOTO 190
150 IF V = 0 THEN LET R0 = X : PRINT "BMP280 ID "; Q
155 IF V > 0 AND X <> R0 THEN PRINT "V"; V; " FAIL 3" : GOTO 190
160 GOSUB 1000 : IF F <> 0 THEN PRINT "V"; V; " FAIL SPEED" : GOTO 190
170 PRINT "V"; V; " OK R "; FQ; " kHz W "; FW; " kHz"
175 PRINT "  READ 255 B = "; MS; " ms"
190 NEXT V
195 WAIT 0 : END
1000 REM --- SPEED, 4 S EACH, MINUS CALL OVERHEAD OV: FQ READ, FW WRITE ---
1010 POKE TX, &88 : POKE IA, D, 1, 255 : A = IC
1015 GOSUB 1800 : IF F <> 0 THEN RETURN
1020 T = H / N - OV : MS = INT (T * 1000 + .5) : FQ = INT (2322 / T / 1000 + .5)
1030 POKE TX, 0 : POKE IA, D, 255, 0 : GOSUB 1800
1040 T = H / N - OV : FW = INT (2304 / T / 1000 + .5)
1050 IF F <> 0 THEN LET FW = 0 : LET F = 0
1060 RETURN
1100 REM --- SECONDS OF THE HOUR FROM TIME (MMDDHH.mmss) INTO X ---
1110 Q = INT ((TIME - INT (TIME)) * 10000 + .5)
1120 X = INT (Q / 100) * 60 + Q - 100 * INT (Q / 100) : RETURN
1500 REM --- VERIFY: F=0 OK 1 BUS 2 ID 4 WRITE 5 READ BACK, X = SIGNATURE ---
1510 F = 0 : POKE TX, &D0 : POKE IA, D, 1, 1 : CALL IC, E
1515 IF E <> 0 THEN LET F = 1 : RETURN
1520 Q = PEEK (RX) : IF (Q < 86 OR Q > 88) AND Q <> 96 THEN LET F = 2 : RETURN
1530 POKE TX, &88 : POKE IA, D, 1, 24 : CALL IC, E
1535 IF E <> 0 THEN LET F = 1 : RETURN
1540 X = 0 : FOR I = 0 TO 23 : X = X + (I + 1) * PEEK (RX + I) : NEXT I
1550 FOR M = 0 TO 2 : P = M * 84 : POKE TX, &F5, P : POKE IA, D, 2, 0
1551 CALL IC, E
1552 IF E <> 0 THEN LET F = 4
1554 POKE TX, &F5 : POKE IA, D, 1, 1 : CALL IC, E : IF E <> 0 THEN LET F = 4
1556 IF PEEK (RX) <> P THEN LET F = 5
1558 NEXT M : RETURN
1800 REM --- TIME CALLS OF THE ROUTINE AT A FOR 4 S: N CALLS IN H SECONDS ---
1805 F = 0 : E = 0
1810 GOSUB 1100 : Y = X
1820 GOSUB 1100 : IF X = Y THEN 1820
1830 W = X : N = 0
1840 FOR K = 1 TO 4 : CALL A, E : NEXT K : N = N + 4
1845 IF E <> 0 THEN LET F = 1 : RETURN
1850 GOSUB 1100 : H = X - W : IF H < 0 THEN LET H = H + 3600
1860 IF H < 4 THEN 1840
1870 RETURN
2000 REM --- POKE DATA BLOCKS (N,ADDRESS,BYTES...; 0 ENDS) ---
2010 READ N : IF N = 0 THEN RETURN
2020 READ A : FOR I = 1 TO N : READ B : POKE A, B : A = A + 1 : NEXT I
2030 GOTO 2010
3500 REM --- FIRST INSTALLATION: NEW "S0:",&800 MUST HAVE BEEN TYPED ---
3510 H = PEEK (63589) : H = H + 128 - 256 * INT (H / 128)
3512 S = H * 256 + PEEK (63590)
3520 PRINT "PROGRAM AT "; S; " (&C800 = 51200)"
3522 INPUT "DID YOU TYPE NEW S0 &800 (Y)"; A$ : IF A$ <> "Y" THEN END
3530 RETURN
